mintAuthority.summary: KRWQ has one issuer-native deployment on Ethereum. Its 3-of-5 Safe can authorize any nonzero token minter; minterMint has no collateral or token-level cap check. D14 issuance is economically unbounded despite deposit/oracle checks and mutable caps in the two current custodians. Whole-supply reconciliation remains unverified. LayerZero OFT representations and the Ethereum OFT Adapter remain exclusively in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: KRWQ Ethereum owner (3/5 Safe)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770699 (2026-08-16), the KRWQ TransparentUpgradeableProxy implementation 0x350b6b5cf2bda130a9bee0a3cda86ec88e71dcca exposes minterMint(address,uint256) only to addresses in the minters mapping; the token function itself has no token-level cap, and addMinter/removeMinter are owner-only. The two active minters are KRWTCustodianWithOracle proxies 0x5573b8db24043bee020c36ee0df32694dffef04c and 0x7e88ac6a9c2dad21fea4de6b54c764ca4d99c05d, both owned by this 3-of-5 Safe. Each custodian uses deposit/custodian-asset and oracle-freshness checks and currently reports mintCap = 1,500,000,000e18; the Safe can raise those caps, add or remove minters, and owns the Ethereum mint-critical ProxyAdmins. getModules() returned empty, while current guard/fallback reads reverted, so guard state is not claimed absent.
controls.capDescription: Current custodian minters enforce deposit/oracle checks and 1.5 billion KRWQ caps, but owner-only addMinter can authorize any nonzero address. Token minterMint checks only authorization, not collateral or a token-level cap; D14 root issuance is economically unbounded.

review.evidence: Reviewed at the Mint Authority / Bridge Risk boundary on 2026-08-16 using pinned 2026-08-16 observations. Ethereum is the only issuer-native liability route: the KRWQ token proxy is owner-controlled by the 3-of-5 Safe 0x56398b89, its two active KRWTCustodianWithOracle minters enforce deposit/custodian-asset and oracle-freshness checks with 1,500,000,000e18 caps, and the Safe can raise those caps, change the minter set, or replace the token and custodian mint-critical implementations. Base, Polygon, Fraxtal, Codex, and Morph are LayerZero OFT bridge representations; their destination mint/burn, peer, owner, and upgrade machinery, plus the Ethereum OFT Adapter escrow, are scored only under bridgeRouteRisk. The assets-only Chainlink Proof of Reserve does not reconcile total liabilities across the canonical token, Adapter, and five representations, so reconciliation remains unknown and no independent supervisor is evidenced. D14/D29 review on 2026-10-03 confirmed token owner() at Ethereum block 26112822 (hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a) and read verified KRWQ source. addMinter(address) requires onlyOwner, a nonzero address and absence from the mapping; it does not constrain minters to deposit-backed custodians. minterMint(address,uint256) checks onlyMinters then calls _mint to a chosen recipient without collateral or a token-level cap. The Safe can therefore admit an unrestricted minter without upgrading; D14 semantics are unbounded. Safe authority is not D29 token governance. Unknown reconciliation and no supervision derive unbounded-reconciliation-unknown.
